- changed-path allowlist check -> only README.md and docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/**

## Evidence boundary
No Host launch/install, TCC/System Settings, codesign/security/keychain, adb reverse/device operation, or swift run was performed. This follow-up only updates aggregate metadata and retained evidence for the current-source blocked decision.

The remaining non-pass Phase 0 gates are:
- macos_host_hardware_compatibility_matrix
- telemetry_and_latency_archive
- host_rss_2h_no_growth
- native_pointer_hid_mouse
- controller_runtime_acceptance
